data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 4/5): Test harness must invoke each defined test function (not just define them). Add dispatcher at file bottom: loop over named tests, run each in subshell with trap-cleanup, count PASS/FAIL, exit non-zero if any failed. Add AC: 'Script ends with main dispatcher invoking all named test functions and prints final SUMMARY line with FAILED:<N>'. Without this, task-3 GREEN-verify (FAILED:0 grep) silently passes on non-dispatching script. Also remove redundant test-index marker for telemetry_emit.py — task-1 owns it.
